rationale: Extends apps/docs/scripts/verify-static-budget.mjs from the single installation route to every enumerable docs route. Ten routes currently exceed the frozen 300000 byte cap for docs-total-transfer-compressed because the enforcement point was previously the installation route alone. Each over-cap route is grandfathered at its measured 2026-08-17 value; every future build must be strictly non-worsening against its ceiling, and every non-grandfathered route must respect the 300000 byte cap. Phase 3 exit criterion, per docs/decisions/docs-performance-baselines.md: every grandfathered ceiling equals capUnderRatchet (i.e. every over-cap route has been shrunk to 300000 or below) before Phase 3 marks complete. Cap widening is a separate explicit user decision that must land in performance-budgets.json first.
